style: Warm, calm, modern flat-vector illustration with a touch of paper-cut softness. Shapes are geometric and rounded, with generous corner radii and no hard outlines; edges are crisp but friendly, with a faint 1px tonal edge only where needed for separation. Shading is minimal: flat fills plus one soft secondary tone per object and a gentle, low-opacity contact shadow beneath plates and bowls, lit as if by diffuse morning window light from the upper left. Surfaces feel like matte ceramic, woven cloth, and fresh food with tiny highlight dots, never glossy or photoreal. Compositions are mostly top-down or straight-on, uncluttered, with plenty of breathing room and off-white (#FAF7F2) grounds, deep green as the anchor, and saffron as the single warm accent. Food is appetizing and culturally respectful (dal, roti, rice, injera, ugali, arepas, tortillas, beans, greens), with no people, no needles, no blood, no medical crosses, no text. Mood is reassuring, capable, and quietly optimistic, like a kind home cook rather than a clinic. Everything reads clearly at small sizes on low-end Android screens, with limited colour counts and no heavy gradients, so the art stays light as SVG and works in light, dark, and high-contrast themes.
